title.en: Add an IM group invite link

descriptions.zh:
><notice>通过API添加IM群邀请链接功能属于Meta内测功能，请联系您的商务经理申请加白。></notice>

- 在调用此接口之前，请确保您已有创建成功的IM群。

- 若您没有已创建成功的IM群，可通过[AddChatGroup](~~2998429~~)接口创建IM群。

- 在调用此接口添加IM群邀请链接后，您可使用此链接邀请成员进入IM群。

- 进入IM群的方式暂只支持通过邀请链接的方式进入。

- 通道类型为WhatsApp的群组成员最大数量为8人。
descriptions.en:
><notice>Adding IM group invite links through the API is a Meta beta feature. Contact your account manager to apply for access.></notice>

- Before calling this operation, make sure that you have a successfully created IM group.

- If you do not have a successfully created IM group, call the [AddChatGroup](~~2998429~~) operation to create one.

- After you call this operation to add an IM group invite link, you can use the link to invite members to join the IM group.

- Currently, members can join an IM group only through an invite link.

- The maximum number of members in a WhatsApp group is 8.
